PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: A summary of what we collect, why, who can see it, and who helps us run DUEL. DUEL uses virtual money only.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Intro: Depending on how you use DUEL, we process:

section1Items.account: Account information: your email address and sign-in records, handled by Supabase Auth. We never see or store your raw password.
section1Items.google: Google sign-in (optional): if you choose it, Google and Supabase process the information needed to sign you in, and we may receive account identifiers and profile information from that process. We never receive your Google password.
section1Items.profile: Profile: your username and an optional avatar you upload. Avatars are resized and stored as JPEG images.
section1Items.social: Friends and activity: friend requests, accepted friendships, and a last-seen timestamp that shows your online activity to accepted friends.
section1Items.game: Game data: rooms you create or join, room settings, timestamps, virtual balances, positions, orders, trade amounts and prices, match results, and statistics.
section1Items.technical: Technical and security data: IP address, browser and device details, session data, errors, and security or abuse events. Our logs can include account identifiers and submitted order details, and our hosting providers may keep their own logs.
section1Items.support: Support messages: anything you choose to send us.

PrivacyPolicy.section2: We don't ask for payment cards, bank details, or real trading accounts. DUEL doesn't accept deposits, execute real trades, or pay prizes. We don't use your information for targeted advertising.

section3Items.account: Create and secure your account and sign you in
section3Items.play: Run matches: rooms, market data, simulated orders, results, rankings, and match history
section3Items.social: Power profiles and friends, including showing when friends are online
section3Items.support: Respond to your questions and requests
section3Items.security: Monitor and troubleshoot the service, and prevent cheating, fraud, and abuse

section4Items.players: Signed-in players can see your username and avatar, and can see public rankings.
section4Items.friends: Accepted friends can see your last-seen activity. Friend requests are visible to the people involved.
section4Items.match: Match participants can access that match's records, including trades. Right now, our database rules let your opponent read your recorded trades during a match as well as after it ends, even though the live screen doesn't show them. Don't treat in-progress trades as hidden from your opponent.
section4Items.sharing: We share information with the service providers listed below, and when required by law, to protect users and the service, or as part of a business transfer.

PrivacyPolicy.section5Intro: DUEL relies on these services, which handle information under their own terms and privacy notices:

section5Items.supabase: Supabase: authentication, database, and avatar storage
section5Items.google: Google: only if you choose Google sign-in
section5Items.coinbase: Coinbase Exchange API: BTC market data used in matches
section5Items.monitoring: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana: operational monitoring and alerts

PrivacyPolicy.section6: We use sign-in and session cookies (managed through Supabase) and a locale cookie that remembers your language. Both are for core features. We don't use advertising cookies. You can clear them in your browser at any time, but you'll be signed out.
PrivacyPolicy.section7: We keep your account and game records for as long as your account exists, and we don't currently have an automatic deletion schedule. Server logs and copies held by our providers or in backups may be kept for as long as needed for security and operations. If you ask us to delete your account, we'll remove your personal data, though some anonymized match records may be kept for platform integrity.
PrivacyPolicy.section8: You can change your username and avatar in Settings, remove a custom avatar, and sign out at any time. Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to access, correct, delete, or get a copy of your personal information, or to object to certain uses of it. To make a request, contact us (see section 12). We may need to verify your identity first. There's no self-service account deletion yet, so deletion requests are handled by email.
PrivacyPolicy.section9: We use managed authentication, access controls, and database Row Level Security. No online service is completely secure. If a security incident affects your information, we'll take the steps the law requires.
PrivacyPolicy.section10: DUEL is intended for people aged 18 or older. If you believe someone under that age has given us personal information, contact us so we can look into it and act.
PrivacyPolicy.section11: We may update this policy as DUEL changes. If we make a material change, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
PrivacyPolicy.section12: Questions, requests, or complaints about your data? Email us at
PrivacyPolicy.section12Note: You may also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

HowToPlay.title: How to play
HowToPlay.intro: Two players, one chart (BTC, ETH or SOL against USDT), equal starting capital. The chart replays the last few hours of real 1-minute prices, sped up to one candle every half second. Whoever finishes the match with more capital wins.

createJoin.title: Create or join a room
createJoin.detail: Create a room and you're automatically seated as player one. Join an open room and you're seated as player two. Either way, the match settings (symbol, duration, starting capital) are locked in.

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.detail: Once both seats are filled, a short countdown starts. Nobody can trade yet. This is just enough time to get ready before the chart goes live.

live.title: The match goes live
live.detail: Both players see the exact same price stream. From here you can place Long or Short trades until the clock runs out.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.detail: The moment the timer hits zero, any exposure you're still holding is automatically closed at the final price. Nothing carries over.

trading.title: Placing a trade
trading.intro: Every trade is a market order. You pick an amount and a direction, and it fills instantly at the current streamed price. There's no limit order, no leverage, and no fees.

long.label: Long
long.detail: You profit if the price rises above your entry price by the time you offset or the match ends.

short.label: Short
short.detail: You profit if the price falls below your entry price by the time you offset or the match ends.

trading.positionTitle: You only ever hold one position
trading.positionDetail: There's no separate “close” button. An opposite-side trade offsets your existing exposure first, and any leftover amount opens a new position in the other direction.
trading.positionExample: e.g. holding a $50 Short → a $50 Long trade fully closes it. A $80 Long would close the $50 Short and open a new $30 Long.

priceTimer.label: Price & timer
priceTimer.detail: Top bar — current price and time left in the match.

capital.label: Your capital
capital.detail: Available balance plus whatever's tied up in an open position.

exposure.label: Exposure panel
exposure.detail: Your current side, entry price, and unrealised profit or loss if you offset right now.

opponent.label: Opponent
opponent.detail: You'll see their capital total live. Their individual trades stay hidden until the match ends.

ending.title: How a match ends
ending.detail: When the timer runs out, the server closes any open position at the final price. You never have to remember to close a trade yourself. Whoever ends up with more capital wins. If you're tied exactly, it's a draw. Full trade-by-trade detail is available afterward from the match history.

ready.detail: Jump into an open room, or start your own.
